newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - July 17.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - July 17.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the Japanese press on Thursday, as reported by Kyodo news agency.
-- Finance Ministry panel to consider extending deposit insurance system to cover bank debentures.
-- Japan and United States to hold working-level talks on defense cooperation guidelines on July 29.
-- Lawyer for Azabu Building arrested for alleged fake registration.
